concepts.proposed_markdown: The deprecated Plans `POST /v1/credits/createGrant` creates a customer credit grant with required granted and paid amounts, expiry, display name, and priority within a supplied payload. Optional effective timing and product IDs govern when and where the grant applies; product omission applies it across all products, while supplied product order controls invoice-line application order. Optional resource-level `uniqueness_key` rejects reuse with HTTP `409`, and opt-in beta rollover settings can cap a successor grant by percentage or fixed amount. The page does not establish balance or ledger visibility, propagation timing, invoice/payment outcomes, rollover atomicity, or a Contracts replacement mapping. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credit-grants-create-a-credit-grant]]
warnings: Preserve the deprecated Plans scope and do not infer current Contracts lifecycle behavior.

concepts.anchor: Deprecated Plans endpoints and Contract routing
concepts.proposed_markdown: The deprecated Plans `POST /v1/credits/createGrant` creates a credit grant for one Metronome customer and directs new clients to Contracts. It does not name a replacement operation, define a Plan-grant-to-Contract-credit identity or field mapping, supply migration steps, or state a removal date. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credit-grants-create-a-credit-grant]]
warnings: Do not present an existing Contracts credit endpoint as an explicitly documented one-to-one replacement.

concepts.proposed_markdown: On the deprecated Plans credit-grant create surface, optional `product_ids` limits a grant to selected products; omission applies credits to charges for all products, and array order determines credit application order across invoice line items. The page does not define empty-array behavior, invalid or duplicate IDs, later-created products, or interaction with current Contract applicability and priority rules. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credit-grants-create-a-credit-grant]]
